# memlocal_core (vendored)

Source: https://github.com/memlocal/memlocal_core, commit `d46d09c54b30da0bd2a4629ae61daa3b42be3c59`, Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).

Kept: the Flutter plugin (`flutter/`) and the root Rust crate it builds (`Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `src/`). Removed: `flutter/example`, `flutter/coexistence_smoke`, docs and tests. The first commit of this directory is upstream unchanged; the commits after it are this project's changes (`git log -- third_party/memlocal_core`).
